operations.nextFinishLine: #0185 independently checks actual admitted pair; #0186 binds exact observations/candidate; #0085 publishes only that new-name adapter.

operations.operation: Synchronize the selected date through two declared ordered units

operations.nextFinishLine: #0086 exercises one actual admitted pair, between-member failure and matching-receipt resume without replay.

operations.operation: Remove exactly one supported OwnerName property

operations.location: Selected sidecar.xmp document/ordinal/form and whole-property range

operations.nextFinishLine: #0089 qualifies actual one-field removal; #0090 audits RAW, previews, originals and recovery residuals.

operations.operation: Set an existing singleton label; separately create missing property
operations.identity: {http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/}Label
operations.location: Explicit XMP packet/occurrence; creation location must be separately bound
operations.inputView: raw Unicode text; normalized copy only under named reversible mapping
operations.preservationBasis: Retain all unselected XML bytes/semantics; equal value means no rewrite/backup; absence differs from unread
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0024: freeze one singleton existing-label authored candidate contract before implementation; test changed/equal/absent/duplicate, escaping and unknown siblings. Missing-property insertion stays separate.

operations.operation: Set exactly one x-default caption entry
operations.identity: {http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/}description / language x-default
operations.location: Explicit XMP rdf:Alt entry; no implicit native CR3 caption alias

operations.preservationBasis: Exact selected-entry lexical range plus semantic sibling/qualifier verification; no implicit repair or unknown-data stripping
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0024: specify one existing plain-text x-default entry and reject duplicate/unsupported qualified forms; authored changed/equal/empty/escape vectors. Embedded CR3 caption tag/layout remains unknown and unsupported.

operations.operation: Replace/append/remove-index/remove-all on one subject bag; deduplicate separately
operations.identity: {http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/}subject / rdf:Bag; exact item ordinal
operations.location: Selected XMP packet/property/container/item; unknown qualifiers refuse this slice
operations.inputView: raw ordered strings with multiplicity; explicit equality level
operations.preservationBasis: Append retains duplicates; index removes one; remove-all explicit; whole replacement declares losses; preserve unselected lexical/semantic siblings
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0024: freeze a one-property plain-string bag contract with bounded items and exact ordinal operations; independently execute VAL-001..004. Deduplicate must first specify equality, survivor/order and loss policy; no semantics invented here.

operations.operation: Set x-default or delete only fr in an existing rights language alternative
operations.identity: {http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/}rights / language x-default or fr
operations.location: Explicit existing XMP rdf:Alt entry and original lexical ordinal
operations.inputView: raw language spelling/text; case-insensitive key identity
operations.preservationBasis: Preserve other languages, order, spelling and qualifiers; no fabricated x-default
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0024: freeze exactly two existing-entry operations with duplicate case-key refusal and authored VAL-005/006 plus missing-entry and unknown-sibling controls.

operations.operation: Merge named fields or explicitly replace a whole structure
operations.identity: No production property selected; authored known/unknown field names only
operations.location: Synthetic structure; actual XMP expanded property/path/qualifiers unresolved
operations.inputView: raw typed structure; no flattening
operations.preservationBasis: Merge preserves unknown siblings; replacement names each lost sibling; duplicated expanded fields refuse
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0024: record exact expanded property and representation before an executable slice; then compare merge versus replacement on VAL-007/008 and unknown/duplicate/qualified controls. Production family cardinality remains unknown.

operations.operation: Copy Artist to creator under the existing synthetic mapping; retain two-way original-copy control
operations.identity: proposal:exif/Artist@1 to proposal:xmp-dc/creator@1; exact occurrence IDs required
operations.location: Original RAW occurrence and explicit XMP creator sequence insertion; actual admitted representation unresolved
operations.inputView: normalized string under proposal:string-to-creator-sequence-v1, never display
operations.preservationBasis: Freeze every source before effects; no earlier write feeds later copy; named mapping/loss policy, unknown dependency refusals
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0024: bound one Artist-to-creator intent and its insertion mapping first; independent VAL-009 swap oracle must distinguish snapshot from sequential evaluation. This does not admit Canon writes or creator serialization.

operations.operation: Normalized rational no-op versus explicit raw-pair set
operations.identity: proposal:exif/ExposureTime@1 / Exif 0x829a; exact physical occurrence required
operations.location: CMT/IFD allocation is not fixed by the synthetic identity; production layout unresolved

operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0023: freeze one actual allocation/type/byte-order/dependency map before implementation; authored VAL-010/011, denominator sign/zero/overflow and exact complement controls do not grant positive format admission.

operations.operation: Set typed null only for a destination definition explicitly allowing it
operations.identity: No eligible production definition selected; null is never delete
operations.location: Synthetic value only; actual destination/container/layout unresolved
operations.inputView: raw tagged null, distinct from absent/empty/invalid/unavailable
operations.preservationBasis: No deletion/insertion/reinterpretation inferred; unsupported destination refuses
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0023/#0024: select one explicitly null-capable definition and retained encoding before an executable slice; VAL-012 must distinguish set-null, delete, empty and absent. Family size stays unknown.

operations.operation: Grow/shrink embedded metadata allocations without changing photograph interpretation
operations.identity: No additional CR3 tag/layout selected; caption/EXIF/GPS/embedded XMP are residual families
operations.location: CMT, container gaps, maker notes, references, previews and opaque regions as actually discovered
operations.inputView: raw encoded values plus named normalized transforms only
operations.preservationBasis: Every changed length/count/offset/padding/checksum/dependency must be justified; equal sensor bytes do not clear opaque relocation
operations.nextFinishLine: Within #0023: select one concrete field/allocation and exact before/after layout map before coding; independent grow/shrink/relocation refusal evidence and RAW usability checks under grants. Number of undefined layouts is unknown.

operations.operation: Create or delete one field/block with explicit allocation/defaults/losses
operations.identity: No extra CR3 field/block selected; native privacy selectors retain catalog identity
operations.location: Exact insertion/deletion region and all moved references unresolved
operations.inputView: raw typed values; explicit deletion intent
operations.preservationBasis: No inferred defaults; all dependent fields, offsets and removed bytes disclosed; protected/unknown data unchanged
operations.nextFinishLine: Within existing owners: bind one exact region/definition and absence proof, required defaults and losses; unknown family stays unknown. Do not treat missing XMP date or an empty sidecar as supported creation.

operations.operation: Date shift/calendar/zone repair or geotag transform

operations.location: Native/sidecar destinations and dependent companions remain operation-specific

operations.preservationBasis: No host timezone, leap normalization, calendar carry or companion update inferred
operations.nextFinishLine: #0133 supplies its bounded contract; each later mutation requires exact writable destinations, dependency map and independent transform vectors before implementation.

operations.operation: Direct CTMD edit, stored-preview replacement, C-RAW or DPRAW mutation

operations.location: Unsupported CTMD, preview payload or unqualified capture variant

operations.preservationBasis: Sensor/extra planes/CFA/calibration/previews and opaque dependencies independently preserved; no silent sidecar fallback
operations.nextFinishLine: Record specific refusal and zero publication; a future exact variant/preview operation needs separately named representation, grant and independent preservation proof.

operations.operation: Ordinary/case-only paired rename, two-name cycle, cross-volume move separately

operations.location: Same-volume no-replace names; cross-volume copy/verify/publish/delete remains separate

operations.preservationBasis: Byte identity, collision/alias guards, properties and recoverable names; never delete unsafe source or claim cross-volume atomicity
operations.nextFinishLine: #0212 binds one actual pair rename; #0213 one two-name exchange. Cross-volume positive operation is unselected residual within #0026, not satisfied by same-volume tests.

operations.operation: Replace existing target, restore current version safely, prune exact unneeded backup

operations.preservationBasis: Strict expected-old exclusion and complete retained properties; current later edit preserved; prune only verified owned no-longer-needed artifacts

operations.operation: Two-member replacement/resume and independently ordered batch outcomes

operations.location: Per-file units, paired names and original read sets

operations.nextFinishLine: #0214 binds one actual replacement pair and receipt resume; #0096 supplies marker evidence only. General batch/group graph remains undefined within #0026.

operations.operation: Other native GPS/serial removals and provenance invalidation

operations.location: RAW/XMP/previews/backups and opaque residuals explicitly separate

criteria.title: Preview an EOS R5 full RAW caption change; save a plan if requested. Try an imported plan with fabricated capability/authorization fields.
criteria.required: No target mutation. The requested plan is the only new artifact. Application recomputes trust/capability checks; imported fields do not authorize a write.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Edit/create a paired XMP label, including an absent value and an already equal value.
criteria.required: RAW bytes remain identical. Existing XMP retains unselected data; creation uses an explicit path and property policy. A valid no-op creates no backup and does not rewrite XMP.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Change eligible CR3 EXIF/GPS/XMP with growth and shrinkage around maker notes, padding, previews and opaque blocks.
criteria.required: Sensor samples, additional required planes, calibration/CFA interpretation and unselected previews remain intact. All moved references remain valid. Unprovable opaque relocation refuses before publication.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Request a direct read-only CTMD edit, unsupported preview replacement, or an unverified C-RAW/DPRAW layout.
criteria.required: Specific unsupported outcome, no embedded change, and no silent sidecar fallback. Full RAW evidence does not enable secondary variants.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Replace an input/copy source, stage or destination parent between planning, validation and publication; run an unrelated competing editor. Also change a relevant new-output filesystem property at each OD-11 check boundary.
criteria.required: Byte/object/path substitution must not publish an unvalidated object or overwrite a winner; refuse/conflict before publication or report recovery-required when publication may have occurred. Detected OD-11 property changes follow the same before/after outcome boundary; undetected same-owner property edits between observations are outside its continuous-exclusion promise. No stale overwrite or automatic recovery over an external version.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Use a symlink/reparse target, multi-link file, case-folding collision or destination created after preview. For OD-11 new outputs, observe unexpected link topology at each required check.
criteria.required: Default link-policy refusal or evidenced explicit policy; conditional new-name collision refusal. No existence-check-only overwrite. Observed unexpected topology refuses/becomes uncertain at the publication boundary; continuous same-owner link exclusion is not inferred. Required byte/object/path guards remain effective.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Edit read-only media or a file whose ACL/owner/streams cannot be preserved; compare ordinary and explicit preserve-mtime requests. Verify an OD-11 new output's declared private policy and ordinary owner editing after exit.
criteria.required: Required property failure refuses. Real edits update mtime by default; capture dates remain unaltered unless planned. Source properties stay unchanged; do not silently clone ACL/owner/streams. Unsupported explicit carry-through refuses. New output must be private and ordinarily owner-editable, with declared boundary checks rather than continuous same-owner property exclusion.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Exhaust space, corrupt a candidate, fail a recovery copy or fail each prepublication flush. Repeat with no-backup selected.
criteria.required: No target publication; retain required recovery artifacts. No-backup never skips temporary original recovery or scratch-space checks.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Kill/cancel or turn a disposable VM off before, during and after publication; fail installed checks, namespace persistence and receipt persistence separately.
criteria.required: Earlier cancellation does not publish. Ambiguous later states need recovery. Recovery inspects actual identities and makes a best-effort classification; it never guesses a rollback or promises physical-power survival.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Commit the RAW member, then fail the paired XMP member; resume an append after an interrupted batch.
criteria.required: Report partial pairing and each member's actual outcome. Do not continue broken dependencies. Skip a matching committed receipt; never append twice or reuse a receipt after an external edit.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Rename a RAW/XMP pair, a case-only name, a rename cycle, and a cross-volume move; fail destination publication or source removal.
criteria.required: Explicit collision-safe plan. Cross-volume workflow is not advertised as atomic. Unsafe source removal leaves verified destination plus source and reports partial work.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Restore over a later edited target; prune a backup still needed for recovery or a path injected into an untrusted record.
criteria.required: Restore needs a fresh plan and preserves the current version by default. Refuse in-use/unowned prune targets and arbitrary recovery paths.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Scrub sidecar location while RAW duplicates, embedded previews or opaque blocks may retain it; keep an original backup.
criteria.required: Report exact checked/removed/residual/unknown coverage and retained copies. Never certify whole-photo anonymization or secure erasure.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Encounter a known signature/provenance structure affected by the proposed change.
criteria.required: Refuse until a verified preservation or explicit invalidation workflow exists. Do not silently strip the structure or claim signature validity.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Fail cleanup after a fully verified commit; restart with incomplete, foreign or inaccessible recovery records.
criteria.required: Report committed plus pending cleanup when justified; otherwise preserve uncertainty. Do not repeat the edit or delete artifacts by filename pattern.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.

criteria.title: Attempt replacement on an unverified storage profile, including a network/cloud/removable location.
criteria.required: Refuse before publication or offer an explicit independently supported output workflow. Simulation or one successful write never enables a profile.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Scoped child evidence is not completion of this full SAF scenario.
